run_signal_processing: run the signal processing algorithm on a synthetic test signal and print correlation and noise reduction metrics
generate_test_signal: generate a synthetic noisy test signal with multiple frequency components and non-stationary behavior
process_signal: process an input time series using either a basic or enhanced sliding window filter
refactor_enhanced_filter_with_trend_pres: refactor the enhanced filter to use a different weighting scheme for trend preservation
review_adaptive_filter: review the adaptive filter sliding window implementation for performance improvements
